# Details about the application[¶](#details-about-the-application "Permanent link")

This page covers the technical details of the application process: which platform to use, deadlines, required documents, and common questions.

## M1 Application[¶](#m1-application "Permanent link")

* For M1: Depending on whether you are eligible to apply through [trouverMonMaster](https://www.trouvermonmaster.gouv.fr/master/universite-paris-saclay-1/informatique-67?q=informatique&institution=universite%20paris-saclay&position=0&layout=1) (the new French national platform) or not, you must do one or the other:
* if you can use [trouverMonMaster](https://www.trouvermonmaster.gouv.fr/master/universite-paris-saclay-1/informatique-67?q=informatique&institution=universite%20paris-saclay&position=0&layout=1), **then you must do so**. Si c'est le cas vous parlez très probablement francais. A priori, si vous êtes Francais, ou que vous avez fait des études en France depuis une ou plusieurs années, vous DEVEZ passer par ce portail.
* if you **cannot** have a [trouverMonMaster](https://www.trouvermonmaster.gouv.fr/master/universite-paris-saclay-1/informatique-67?q=informatique&institution=universite%20paris-saclay&position=0&layout=1) account, then you **must apply through the Université Paris Saclay portal** ([inception](https://inception.universite-paris-saclay.fr/en/accueil/)). This is typically the case if you are a foreigner and have not studied in France recently.

In short: EU nationals, residents of France, and residents of EEA countries can use trouverMonMaster. Everyone else must use the Inception portal.

 Who can use trouverMonMaster? (original French text from monmaster.gouv.fr)

Source: [monmaster.gouv.fr FAQ](https://www.monmaster.gouv.fr/questions-frequentes-candidature)

**Quels sont les candidats étrangers qui peuvent candidater via monmaster.gouv.fr ?**

Peut candidater sur la plateforme :

* **Un candidat dont la nationalité est européenne (Andorre, Suisse et Monaco étant inclus) ;**
* **Un candidat d’une autre nationalité qui réside en France ;**
* Un candidat d’une autre nationalité qui réside dans un pays de l’Espace économique européen (Andorre, Suisse et Monaco étant inclus) ;
* Un candidat d'une autre nationalité qui réside dans un pays qui n'est pas couvert par le dispositif [Études en France](https://pastel.diplomatie.gouv.fr/etudesenfrance/dyn/public/authentification/login.html).

Ces deux derniers types de candidats devront régulariser leur situation auprès du consulat français de leur pays de résidence.

Par exemple, un candidat de nationalité non européenne qui réside en Allemagne pourra candidater sur la plateforme (si son diplôme le lui permet), mais devra vérifier que sa situation lui permet de poursuivre des études en France auprès d’un consulat français en Allemagne et, le cas échéant, faire une demande de visa pour études.

![](/assets/cyclops-head.svg)

## M2 Application[¶](#m2-application "Permanent link")

* For M2: You **must apply through the Université Paris Saclay portal (**[inception](https://inception.universite-paris-saclay.fr/en/accueil/)**) in all cases.**

Also, some technical information is present there: <https://www.universite-paris-saclay.fr/en/admission/applying-masters-programmes>. In case of contradiction between this site and the Paris-Saclay one, trust this one here. Except on dates or deadlines, where we may sometimes lag a bit to update from year to year.

Do not apply by email

Please do not send us emails to apply directly — we will not reply. We receive hundreds of applications; processing them by email is not reasonable. Please make sure your attachments are correct when you submit your application on the platform.

![](/assets/cyclops-head.svg)

## Application Deadlines[¶](#application-deadlines "Permanent link")

| Level | Platform | Opens | Closes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| M1 | [Inception](https://inception.universite-paris-saclay.fr) | January 15, 2026 | **March 16, 2026** |
| M1 | [MonMaster](https://www.trouvermonmaster.gouv.fr/) | February 17, 2026 | **March 16, 2026** |
| M2 | [Inception](https://inception.universite-paris-saclay.fr) | March 1, 2026 | **April 1, 2026** |

The exact dates are visible when you create your application on the respective platform.

Tip

Try to apply when you have as many of your current first-semester grades as possible.

![](/assets/cyclops-head.svg)

## Where to Apply[¶](#where-to-apply "Permanent link")

**Where can I apply?**

* Apply to our master via [Inception](https://inception.universite-paris-saclay.fr/en/accueil/) or [trouverMonMaster](https://www.trouvermonmaster.gouv.fr/) (see the [M1](#m1-application) and [M2](#m2-application) sections above). As far as we know, you do **not** need to go through Campus France to apply (but rules might change).
* UPSaclay application portal: [apply here](https://www.universite-paris-saclay.fr/en/admission/apply-master-programmes) — [download instructions](https://www.universite-paris-saclay.fr/sites/default/files/media/2020-02/user_guide_inception_front_office_2020_-_english_0.pdf). [Contact support](mailto:support.jurys@universite-paris-saclay.fr).

Campus France / CEP

As far as we know, Campus France is **not** required to apply to this master (but rules might change). However, if you are from one of the [countries covered by the Études en France procedure](https://www.campusfrance.org/en/application-etudes-en-france-procedure), you will need to go through the [Campus France procedure](https://pastel.diplomatie.gouv.fr/etudesenfrance/dyn/public/authentification/login.html) **after admission** in order to obtain your visa. Do not let this prevent you from applying to our program in the meantime.

![](/assets/cyclops-head.svg)

## Required Documents[¶](#required-documents "Permanent link")

**List of documents to provide with the application:**

* Curriculum Vitae (typically pdf, typically less than 2 pages)
* Letter of motivation/Cover letter: see [How to apply well](../how-to-apply-well/)
* Certified transcripts of grades for all diplomas since high-school (NOT including high school).
* "Fiche de choix" (selection sheet): if you applied to several masters, indicate your order of preference (optional).
* Recommendation letters or internship evaluations.
* A completed [auto-evaluation form](https://forms.gle/QvcmcmXWuSdfDXYdA): <https://forms.gle/QvcmcmXWuSdfDXYdA> (required for both M1 and M2)
* English level certificate **(at least B2).**
* (optional) Dossier VAPP : used to ask for replacing diplomas by professional experience. If you do not know what this is, it means you don't need it.

 Where is the 'Selection Sheet' ('Fiche de choix'), and what is this good for?

It is optional. Simply attach a PDF file with title: "Selection Sheet" including the master programs to which you applied, IN ORDER of PREFERENCE, and numbered

(1) 1st choice (preferred)

(2) 2nd choice

(3) etc.

  Can I apply to multiple masters or 'parcours' (master tracks, in particular Data Science)?

Yes. Then you may tell us the order in the "Fiche de Choix" (optional).

  Why do you ask to fill out the auto-evaluation form?

It mainly allows us to know whether you are serious about applying to our AI Master track, because it takes some time to provide the links. We also want to know whether you actually know how to code, and it's hard to fake git commit histories.

  What if I don't have any code on a git repository?

That's not the end of your application, especially if you're an M1 applicant, but it's probably time to look into git. As indicated on the form: if you lack a full project, answer using a coursework mini-project or Kaggle/DrivenData attempt; include a notebook link and at least one error analysis example.

  What if my code is secret / closed-source?

Link to code that is public and add a remark in the auto-evaluation form as well as in the motivation letter explaining that you've worked for a company that produced closed-source code.

![](/assets/cyclops-head.svg)

## Questions about the Application Process[¶](#questions-about-the-application-process "Permanent link")

 Can I apply both to M1 and M2?

Yes, but you should know which one you prefer, and it may look a bit weird. Explain yourself in your cover letter(s).

  Do I need to apply to both M1 and M2 if I want to be considered for both?

Yes + see above.

  Should the application be in French or in English?

Either way.

  Are there English language level requirements?

**Yes**. Proof of English **level B2 or equivalent.** If your diploma has been taught in English, or if you are from an English-speaking country, then attach a PDF with justifications or explanations.

We are interested in students who can demonstrate good results in **all four parts** of the English language: **Listening, Reading, Writing, and Speaking**.

*We* *accept* *any official certificate, such as* *TOEFL, IELTS, Cambridge English Qualifications, PTE, TOEIC,* *or* *CLES**. (Typically those you have to pay for.)*

*We* *refuse* *all tests where one* *cannot prove that it was passed alone, in real exam conditions* *(such as EF SET, Duolingo, etc. — typically those that are free).*

 TOEIC-specific requirements

**If you choose to submit TOEIC scores**, you must provide results for **both** test modules:

* **TOEIC Listening & Reading:** We expect a highly competitive score of **850 or above**. While 785 is the technical entry point for a B2, our program requires a score well past the 800 mark to ensure your absolute comfort with complex academic and professional materials.
* **TOEIC Speaking & Writing:** You must also take the active-skills module to prove you can communicate and draft texts effectively. We require scores that reflect a solid B2 level (a minimum of **160 for Speaking** and **150 for Writing**).

Important Note

Applications submitting only the TOEIC Listening & Reading certificate will be considered **incomplete** and cannot be processed until the Speaking & Writing scores are provided.

   Are there French level requirements?

No. There are some OPTIONAL classes that can be taken in French, but it is possible to get the degree by taking only classes taught in English.

  Do I need to submit my high-school grade transcript?

No, please don't.

  I submitted my candidature but forgot something, how can I add it?

Unfortunately, you cannot modify a submitted application. You will need to delete your candidature and create a new one (using a new email address).

  I destroyed my application accidentally, can you revert this or accept my files by email?

No. You need to create a new account and re-enter everything on the platform by hand.

  Due to special circumstances (e.g. COVID-19 epidemic) I had to work remotely for my internship, should I mention it?

You can add internships performed remotely in your work experience, as well as other work experiences performed during the confinement, as long as you could perform your duties.

  What are the conditions to attend the M2 level if I am a third-year student of an engineering school (double cursus)?

Contact us for details, this is different every year.

  Do I need to include a 'Dossier VAPP'?

Not necessarily. Only if you cannot demonstrate the right academic profile and you want other personal or professional experiences to be taken into account. See [VAPP](https://www.universite-paris-saclay.fr/formation/formation-continue/vae/validation-des-etudes-experiences-professionnelles-ou-acquis) instructions. This Dossier VAPP can be useful at the M1 or M2 entry level, if you interrupted your studies more than 2 years, and want to capitalize on personal or professional experience to compensate for missing academic credentials.

  As a foreign student, I cannot see my diplomas in the list, what should I select?

* Baccalauréat ou équivalent:
  + Equivalence BAC diplôme ou titre étranger.
  + Equivalence BAC
* Cursus précédent:
  + Bachelor of Science
  I am a foreign student, do I need to complete the Campus France Procedure (CEP) and when?

As far as we know, you do **not** need Campus France to *apply* to our master (but rules might change) — just use the Inception or trouverMonMaster portals.

However, **after admission**, if you come from one of the countries covered by the Études en France procedure and you are not already studying in France, you will need to go through the [Campus France / CEP procedure](https://pastel.diplomatie.gouv.fr/etudesenfrance/dyn/public/authentification/login.html) to obtain your visa. Countries concerned include:

Algérie, Argentine, Bénin, Brésil, Burkina Faso, Burundi, Cameroun, Chili, Chine, Colombie, Comores, Congo, Corée du Sud, Côte d'Ivoire, Djibouti, Egypte, Etats-Unis, Gabon, Guinée, Haïti, Inde, Indonésie, Iran, Japon, Koweit, Liban, Madagascar, Mali, Maroc, Maurice, Mauritanie, Mexique, Nigeria, Pérou, République démocratique du Congo, Russie, Sénégal, Singapour, Taïwan, Tchad, Togo, Tunisie, Turquie, Vietnam.

[See the full updated country list](https://pastel.diplomatie.gouv.fr/etudesenfrance/dyn/public/authentification/login.html).

Start the procedure as soon as you are admitted.

## Université Paris-Saclay, Department of Computer Science[¶](#universite-paris-saclay-department-of-computer-science "Permanent link")

# Artificial Intelligence Master Track[¶](#artificial-intelligence-master-track "Permanent link")

One of the most selective AI master programs in France — in 2026, we received over 2,000 applications for 25 places for the full program and nearly 500 applications for the additional 5 places we offer for entry at the second year. We welcome students with a strong background in **computer science, mathematics, or physics** who want to dive deep into the mathematical foundations of modern AI and apply them to real-world problems.

Our program has a distinctive focus on **Natural Language Processing**: many of the researchers who teach here are active NLP researchers at [LISN](https://www.lisn.upsaclay.fr/) and beyond, which means rich course offerings and abundant research opportunities in this area. A secondary focus is **Scientific Machine Learning** — applying ML to physics, chemistry, and the life sciences. While the program is research-oriented, many of our graduates go on to successful careers in industry. Read more about [what this master program is](admissions/what-is-this-master-program/) and [whether you should apply](admissions/should-i-apply/).

Is this the right program for you?

If you're passionate about the mathematics behind language models, deep learning, and data-driven science, you're in the right place. Beyond mathematics, we emphsize AI applications for language and sciences. If your primary interest is pure mathematics, consider the [M1 Mathématiques et Intelligence Artificielle](https://www.universite-paris-saclay.fr/formation/master/mathematiques-et-applications/m1-mathematiques-et-intelligence-artificielle) at Paris-Saclay. For computer vision at the M2 level, the [MVA master](https://www.master-mva.com/) is an excellent option (Note that this is a 2-year program and there is no access from our M1 to MVA — choose a different M1 if your plan is to go there). You can also explore the other tracks in the [Informatics Master](https://www.universite-paris-saclay.fr/formation/master/informatique). Access to the AI track is also highly restricted for students from other tracks, so if you want to join us, it's best to apply directly to the AI track at the M1 level.

Coordinators of the AI master program: [ai.master-informatique@universite-paris-saclay.fr](mailto:ai.master-informatique@universite-paris-saclay.fr?subject=I%20am%20not%20applying%20through%20mail%20and%20I%20have%20carefully%20read%20all%20the%20AI%20track%27s%20pages%20but%20I%20still%20have%20a%20precise%20question%20that%20I%20cannot%20find%20an%20answer%20to)

In partnership with **Marc Evrard** and **Thomas Gerald** (M2 internship coordination)

# Application Information – 2026 Admissions[¶](#application-information-2026-admissions "Permanent link")

Admissions for 2026 are closed

Applications for 2027 are expected to open in early 2027; exact dates will be posted here once confirmed.

## Application Deadlines 2026[¶](#application-deadlines-2026 "Permanent link")

* **M1 deadline: March 16, 2026**
* **M2 deadline: April 1, 2026**

For admitted students, key dates (arrival, late arrival policy, and planned end dates for M1/M2) are listed on the [After admission page](admissions/after-admission/#key-dates).

It is recommended to apply once you have received **all or most of your first-semester grades**.

For **M1**, the deadline is **March 16** — apply as soon as you have your grades. For **M2**, applications are reviewed in batches; there is no advantage in applying long before the **April 1** deadline.

In recent years, we received **over 1,000 applications for M1** (20–30 available places) and **~400 applications for M2** (~10 available places).

👉 **Please do not email us about your individual case before having precisely studied this page, including [the page "Details about the application"](admissions/details-about-the-application/).**

### Master 1 (First Year) – 2026 Intake[¶](#master-1-first-year-2026-intake "Permanent link")

* **International students:** via **Inception**

### Master 2 (Second Year) – 2026 Intake[¶](#master-2-second-year-2026-intake "Permanent link")

* **Applications via Inception only**

# The AI master[¶](#the-ai-master "Permanent link")

The Paris-Saclay AI track of the Computer Science Master was founded in 2019 by Isabelle Guyon. It is a very selective 2-year master program with 500–1500 applicants at the first-year entry level for ~25 slots. It inherited from a previous 1-year Master 2 program run by Alexandre Allauzen. It includes a rigorous program with foundational courses and more advanced classes in machine learning, computer vision, and natural language processing. It is taught by 17 professors, including 14 Université Paris-Saclay faculty and 3 external experts.

The AI master is a "parcours" (track)  of the Université Paris-Saclay Computer Science (Informatique) master. It delivers a **master diploma in computer science** in 2 years, recruiting at the BAC+3 level (license or bachelor). The classes are taught in English and include:

* **Foundational classes** (math, probability and statistics, signal processing, and optimization)
* **Growth classes** (data science, machine learning, computer vision, and natural language processing)
* **Soft skills** (e.g. Language, communication, entrepreneurship)
* **Practical work** (e.g. Projects, internships, summer schools)

It provides a **balance between theoretical and practical instruction**.

See [CLASS LIST](classes/).

## Paris-Saclay University Overview

### History

Various reports have identified priority actions to be conducted in order to improve the Saclay scientific and technological cluster, such as the 2004 report entitled "Pour un écosystème de la croissance" by Christian Blanc, member of parliament at the time. Twice, in June 2007 and then again in January 2008, the French governement confirmed the project as one of its priorities.

### Education

High Academic Standing: 9,000 Master’s students, 48 mutualized Master’s programs and 350 Master’s tracks coordinated within 8 thematic Schools; 5,500 PhD students in 20 Doctoral schools

Interdisciplinarity is one of Université Paris-Saclay’s key priorities. It offers future researchers and executives education at the very highest level, both conceptual and practical, with a special emphasis on doctoral training and research focused Masters for students with very varied backgrounds. At Master’s and Doctorate level, bridges between “grande école” and university education are another key strength of the University’s strategy.

### Research

The scientific research strategy is part of an array of key areas ranging from fundamental research to applied sciences and industrial issues. This very comprehensive approach is complemented by cross-cutting initiatives on socio-economic issues and the development of shared platforms.

Research at Université Paris-Saclay is thus structured in 10 thematic departments whose primary mission is to contribute to the development of a strategic vision shared by all members in their area of ​​expertise and to coordinate its implementation.

Several key initiatives selected in 2013 and 2014, together with strategic science and equipment projects and interdisciplinary PhDs.

### Career

Over the years, the Université Paris-Saclay founding members have contributed significantly to the education of large number of national and international personalities in the fields of science (2 Nobel Prizes, 6 Fields Medals, 138 ERC laureates …), politics, economics, …

### Accreditation

Université Paris-Saclay provides a master's level education program backed by research of the highest international level, benefiting from the pooling together of the resources and attractiveness of partners, and targeting a diverse student population, willing to reach the highest degree of knowledge to help them access the jobs of the future.

### Campus life

Between Paris and Versailles, Université Paris-Saclay is located in one of the largest economic and private research areas in Europe. It therefore operates in an environment conducive to producing innovation and to the development of industrial activity. Université Paris-Saclay is also a space open to all, nextdoor to a natural, cultural and historical remarkable site:  the national park of High Valley of Chevreuse which remains  a rural area among the most beautiful but also the most coveted of Ile-de-France. The landscapes are marked since the Middle Ages by the presence of lords and influential princes that signify their power by their great iconic areas and abbeys.
